payout_quote: To receive the bonus, mention promo code MK-CHECKING when opening the account or enter it in the online application, open a new CCU Florida checking account, which is subject to approval, establish a direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening and continue a direct deposit of $500 or more into your account for three consecutive months.
steps: Open a new Free Checking Plus account at Community Credit Union of Florida online or in branch, mentioning/entering promo code MK-CHECKING ($5 one-time membership share fee).
Within 90 days of account opening, establish a direct deposit of $500 or more (paycheck, pension, or government benefits; transfers and P2P do not qualify).
Continue a $500+/month direct deposit for three consecutive months.
Receive the $250 incentive, posted by the 5th of the month following the 90 days after meeting the requirements.
catches: Offer available July 1 - September 25, 2026: EXPIRES IN 2 DAYS from verification (9/23/2026).
Requires three CONSECUTIVE months of $500+ direct deposits after the initial qualifying deposit.
Not available to current CCU Florida checking holders, joint owners on a checking account, or anyone who closed a checking account within the past 24 months.
Membership limited to Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk & Volusia Counties, FL.
A $5 one-time membership fee/share is required at account opening.
Acceptable direct deposits: paycheck, pension, government benefits only; account transfers and person-to-person transfers (incl. Zelle) do not qualify.
Incentive posts by the 5th of the month following the 90-day period - a long wait to cash.
Bonus is interest income for tax purposes (taxable).
biggest_catch: The offer EXPIRES September 25, 2026 - two days from verification - so you must open the account immediately; and the payout requires three consecutive months of $500+ qualifying direct deposits before the $250 posts.
eligibility: New CCU Florida checking members; Florida residents of Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk, or Volusia County. Not available to current/joint checking holders or those who closed within 24 months.
timing: Incentive posts by the 5th of the month following the 90 days after requirements are met. Offer expires 9/25/2026 - 2 days from check date.
